desc: Architected and launched a template management application on the Monday.com marketplace, generating $40k+ ARR with workflow automation driving recurring enterprise adoption. Built a custom property management platform for a law firm overseeing 4,000+ apartments, and optimized API calls and load sequences for a 40% improvement in app-load and execution time.

Built 4 customer-facing web applications integrating Stripe, WhatsApp Business, Google Calendar & Jira to replace manual workflows across Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Customer Success. Built a free ATS with 350+ job templates that became a profitable product feature, and standardized development procedures while training 7 junior engineers across Avniro subsidiaries.
